title: A 3D fruit fly on macOS desktop powered by the real FlyWire connectome
summary: A macOS desktop application that renders an interactive 3D visualization of a fruit fly using real neural connectivity data from the FlyWire connectome project, allowing users to explore the Drosophila brain's neural network in real-time on their desktop.
problem_solved: Makes complex neural connectome data accessible and visually engaging by rendering the entire fruit fly brain connectivity in 3D on a desktop environment.
why_valuable: Bridges the gap between neuroscience research data and public accessibility by presenting FlyWire's groundbreaking fruit fly brain connectome as an interactive 3D desktop experience.
